Heated Blanket Gift Idea for Cold Sleepers

By the IndieLab editors · Updated 18 November 2026 · 3 min read

This post contains affiliate links. If you buy through them, IndieLab may earn a commission at no extra cost to you. How this works

Short answer: if you want the version people keep recommending to each other, this is it. A plush electric throw that warms up in minutes — for sofas, beds and anyone who is always cold.

Why does the heated blanket make the list?

  • Adjustable warmth for sofas, beds and reading chairs
  • Costs pennies to run compared with heating a whole room
  • The gift that gets used every single night of winter

What should you check before buying?

  • Check the heat settings and whether it has auto shut-off — most people want both
  • Look at the washing instructions; most heated throws are hand-wash or gentle-cycle with the controller removed
  • Measure your sofa or bed: a throw is smaller than a full electric blanket
  • Check the cord length against where the nearest outlet sits

What are the honest downsides?

It needs a mains outlet nearby, and it warms one person, not a room. If the recipient's home has no spare outlet near the sofa, a non-electric sherpa throw may suit better.

When should you order it?

Order by mid-December to be safe — delivery windows stretch in the last two weeks, and popular gift picks do sell out. Prices also move through the season, so the price on the Amazon page today may not be the price tomorrow. Check the size, colour and pack options before ordering; the most-gifted variant is not always the default one.

Questions, answered

Can you wash an electric heated blanket?

Most are washable on a gentle cycle once the controller is unplugged and removed. Always check the care label on the listing before the first wash.

Is a throw big enough for a bed?

A throw is sized for one person on a sofa or across the foot of a bed. For full-bed coverage, look for a full-size electric blanket instead.

What if she is always cold but hates gadgets?

That is exactly who this suits — there is one simple controller, no apps, no setup. Plug in, pick a heat level, done.

Is a heated blanket a good Christmas gift for mom?

Yes — it is one of the most-used winter gifts there is. Moms who feel the cold use it daily from December to March, on the sofa and in bed.
